# config: git: disable advice.skippedCherryPicks

Silence the warning git prints when a rebase drops commits already applied upstream:

```bash
$ git rebase main
warning: skipped previously applied commit d29d381
hint: use --reapply-cherry-picks to include skipped commits
hint: Disable this message with "git config advice.skippedCherryPicks false"
```

Related to [[DOT-429]]: with squash-merges the situation is routine, not a surprise, so the hint is noise.
